# Anne & Dora

- [Anne](../character/anne.md) — Mentor of — [Dora](../character/dora.md) — teacher helping to bring her up · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) drops by while [Anne](../character/anne.md) is attempting to write, and they discuss their respective teaching experiences, students, and future career ambitions. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves to get a book, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home tired and reveals that her cousin Mary Keith is dying and needs someone to care for her twin children, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) successfully persuades [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take in the twins out of a sense of duty, agreeing to help with their sewing.
>
> — v2 · VII The Pointing of Duty

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose playful and rowdy behavior immediately poses a challenge for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md). At church on Sunday, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates a commotion by dropping a caterpillar down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's neck during the service. Later in the week, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins Dora's dress by forcing her to walk the pigpen fence and pumps water over her, subsequently confessing to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he also hid a toad in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed. [Anne](../character/anne.md) quickly retrieves the toad and carries it outside to the orchard before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) can discover it. Relieved, she notices [Diana](../character/diana.md) signaling to her from her window.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) on his porch about [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Davy's antics, and the Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. Later, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) discovers that [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) has accidentally painted the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up in color codes. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair over the blunder, but the town's sympathy ultimately turns in their favor against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who talks about church preparations, and upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learn from a letter that the twins will stay with them until fall. [Anne](../character/anne.md) recalls a humorous interaction with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) regarding his antics and misinterpretations of the catechism. Later, at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the group is distressed to hear that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence for advertisements, and an unsuccessful committee sent to reason with him leaves them dismayed.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives a letter announcing that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will visit, and she enthusiastically plans a elaborate dinner party with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md). After clearing up Davy's confused ideas about heaven and preparing the house and food, [Anne](../character/anne.md) secures Davy's promise to behave during the upcoming visit.
>
> — v2 · XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

> After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns via a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle and cannot visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) sit together in the evening discussing the day's mishaps, how to replace Miss Barry's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). As they finish talking, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walks up the lane.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolhouse antics and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) scares her with stories of her deceased relatives. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) take a walk through the woods and accidentally lose their way while heading to a tea party. Their wrong turn leads them to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they meet the eccentric Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young maid, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), who invite them to stay for a pretend tea party.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> During breakfast, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the situation with [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), all while managing Davy's lively table manners. [Anne](../character/anne.md) promises to help [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) make an [Indian](../codex/factions.md#indian) headdress using old feathers. Later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund that ensures the twins can remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

> After anonymous newspaper notes predict a severe storm, an unusually devastating hailstorm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), severely damaging crops, trees, and windows. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and the twins shelter through the tempest, later learning that Mr. Harrison's parrot was killed and an eyesore house was struck by lightning. Neighbors assess the ruin, and [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md) basks in his newly acquired fame as a prophet.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

> During dinner, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her outfit and shares stories from school while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tries to keep him in line. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). While [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes and talks about his grandmother's strict rules, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) chat before [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes strawberry picking with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House
